desc: Implement the backward DP states dp1, dp2, and dp3 for run length 1, 2, and at least 3, with base cases at position n, using best/second-best precomputed switch values to avoid O(26^2) transitions, and store all DP layers in memory-efficient flat arrays.
Compute the initial minimum cost from first-character choices and return "" if n < 3 or the cost remains infinite.
Implement greedy left-to-right reconstruction using the stored DP layers to choose the lexicographically smallest optimal caption.

Run the current solution against the provided examples and edge cases (n < 3, n = 3, all-same strings, ties requiring lexicographically smallest output, and boundary characters 'a' and 'z'); no failures were reported.
